scope: Survey-grounded AI4AI catalog organized as Benchmarks, Harness Design, and Model Design.
overlap_policy: A paper may appear in multiple public collections but only once within each collection.
citation_policy: For papers indexed as multiple versions, retain the largest title-verified count reported by the configured sources.
year_grouping: All yearly rankings use first public appearance year; a later venue year never moves a paper into a newer cohort.

research_refresh.note: Re-screened 1,748 distinct recent cs.AI/cs.CL titles with overlap against the November 7 pass and prior documented exclusions. No new agent/memory candidates appeared in that same listing snapshot. An expanded harness, tool-use, self-distillation and post-training sweep found 18 previously missed candidates; cross-category primary search recovered HITCH. Verified all 19 primary arXiv pages and explicit v1 dates: 13 additions and six exclusions. Checked 12 full papers and important author-linked project pages; corrected one existing source-only survey artifact/landing link and resolved Apriel Voice weights. All prior news picks were reassessed and official model/research indexes checked. This bounded research documents recoveries, not exhaustive coverage or newly released November 8 papers.

metrics_refresh.note: Fresh title-verified OpenAlex batches by previously verified work IDs, followed by DOI and title fallback for uncovered records. All previous 1,070 work IDs were reverified. Semantic Scholar probe returned HTTP 429. Nineteen unmatched citation records retain known values or null; no mismatched index title is accepted and counts use max(existing, observed). Authenticated GitHub REST verified every currently configured repository. The repeatedly 404 Picrew/LLM-Harness companion link was corrected to the author-owned Picrew/awesome-agent-harness catalog, whose live README explicitly cites the same survey; its star count belongs to a different artifact and is not a growth measurement. The source-only survey now links the author-cited OpenReview page, but is not promoted because first-publication metadata could not be independently retrieved past the browser challenge. Primary full-paper/project checks also linked Apriel Voice official weights; the HITCH project returned 403, so no unverified GitHub repository was invented.
